decisions.reason: The source expands label coverage and defines label text; it does not change the mechanism or robustness of the editable fields themselves.
Requiring labels on all interactive fields does not change whether placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The source concerns persistent help labels on interactive fields, not the required Word style set or its coverage across templates.
The field-label decision does not change the task-local assessment method, coverage, time budget, or required reporting outputs.
The source does not mention or alter the required template theme colors; the overlap arises only from both requirements concerning templates and interactive-field presentation.
The referenced image defines help-label text for interactive fields and does not modify bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, color, or level variants.
The label-coverage decision does not change the required behavior for copying content from legacy templates into new templates.
Interactive-field labels do not affect the requirement for reliable manual line breaks after pasted content.
The source does not alter Tab-key behavior, list-level creation, hierarchy, or nested-list alignment.
The field-label rule does not change table or column stability when content is pasted.
The source specifies label coverage and matching text but does not modify heading emphasis, title size, typography, or style spacing.
